# Suites that RUN on a blocking CI job but are checked against
# tests/baseline-failures.json instead of being required green.
#
# All 15 fail today. Before the baseline existed they could not be on any job:
# the rule in suites-not-in-ci.txt was "a suite joins CI when it passes, not
# before", because a permanently red job trains everyone to ignore CI. Recording
# known failures BY NAME removes that tradeoff. The `baseline` job runs these on
# every push and goes red only on a failure that is NEW, so a regression inside
# an already-failing suite is no longer invisible.
#
# What this list is NOT: an excuse. Every entry is a real defect in the test or
# the code that someone still has to decide about. Moving a suite here parks the
# question; it does not answer it. Two worth singling out:
#
#   concurrency-convergence  9 of 10 concurrent mutations succeed where the
#                            suite demands 10. This suite exists to prove no
#                            mutation is lost under contention, so if the
#                            assertion is right this is a real lost-mutation bug
#                            in the retry path, not a flaky test.
#
#   monitoring               expects 10, receives a different count from
#                            ApiRequestLog aggregation.
#
# MEASURED INDIVIDUALLY on 2026-09-04, and the CI job runs them one at a time
# for the same reason. In a combined run these suites report 115 failures
# between them; run alone they have 55. Several create and drop schemas, seed
# findings and VACUUM, so sharing a database with each other and with the
# blocking suites manufactures failures that do not exist. Never capture or
# check this baseline from a single monolithic `npx jest` run.
#
# To re-measure after a deliberate fix:
#   npx jest --runTestsByPath <suite> --ci --runInBand --forceExit \
#     --json --outputFile=.jest-baseline/N.json || true
#   npx tsx scripts/test-baseline.ts capture .jest-baseline/*.json
__tests__/concurrency-convergence.test.ts
__tests__/deterministic-executor.test.ts
__tests__/invariants/mutation-safety.test.ts
__tests__/lib/services/databaseBrain.test.ts
__tests__/lib/services/monitoring.test.ts
__tests__/load/concurrency.test.ts
__tests__/load/execution-engine-performance.test.ts
__tests__/suite2.relationships.test.ts
__tests__/suite3.conflicts.test.ts
__tests__/suite4.safety.test.ts
__tests__/suite5.advisory.test.ts
tests/error-communication.test.ts
tests/field-extraction.test.ts
tests/storage-provisioning.test.ts
tests/timeline-granularity.test.ts
